flagship.title: Raven Rock and the stairs down to the Cape Fear
flagship.standfirst: A 2.6-mile loop through pine woods to a 150-foot cliff above the river, with stairs down to its foot and an overlook above.
flagship.why_this_week: The longer-drive choice, only if Saturday morning remains dry and the park is open. The loop and cliff are the outing; the long stairs make wet footing a reason to turn back. October opening is 7 a.m. Sunday thunderstorms are a reason to postpone, not to choose another outdoor trail.

route.surface: Wide woodland path; long wooden stairs down to the river and back up

access.name: Raven Rock State Park, 3009 Raven Rock Rd., Lillington
access.parking: Main lot by the visitor center; the loop starts beside it.

dog.water: Carry drinking water for both; do not rely on river water or enter the river.
watch_for: The stairs: a long climb back up
Current in the Cape Fear: keep him on the leash at the water's edge

photo.alt: Block-print plate: Rupert walks on a bank trail with a tennis ball and a red leash, beside a dark river beneath a full moon and wooded cliffs.

local_trail.title: Carolina North Forest
local_trail.line: Soft trail five minutes from town, if the drive south stops making sense.

away_mission.title: Umstead, Company Mill the long way
away_mission.line: 5.8 miles to the old mill dam on Crabtree Creek. The half-day alternative, with the creek crossed on a bridge.

wildcard.title: Duke Forest, Korstian Division
wildcard.line: Fire roads down to New Hope Creek, fifteen minutes out: an hour, not a day.

mission.text: On the way back up the stairs, practise a sit-and-wait at every landing.

memory_prompt.text: What Rupert notices first from the marked trail above the river; keep him out of the water.

pivot.if: Rain, thunder, flooding or an official closure
pivot.note: Postpone the outing. Another outdoor trail is not a safe thunderstorm fallback. Recheck the official park status and NWS forecast before leaving.

conditions.trail_note: Dry Saturday only. Wet stairs, flooded paths or thunder: turn back or postpone. Stay on marked trails and out of the Cape Fear.

practical.best_window: Dry Saturday morning only; recheck before leaving
practical.closures_note: Official hiking status listed Open on 8 October; recheck before leaving.
